In the original COMMIT_MSG files, 'Validation: links and existing examples preserved; 83 supplied test methods' and 'pass: 100 checks, 51 local links and six JSON examples. Executing the existing builder in memory reproduces both landed messages, ignoring terminal newlines. This corrupts stamped evidence before landing.

import ast, os, re, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('ops/devlane/dispatch/launch.py')
t = ast.parse(p.read_text())
nodes = [n for n in t.body if (isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == '_commit_message') or (isinstance(n, ast.Assign) and any(isinstance(x, ast.Name) and x.id in {'VENDOR', 'MODEL_NAMES'} for x in n.targets))]
ns = {'re': re}
exec(compile(ast.Module(body=nodes, type_ignores=[]), str(p), 'exec'), ns)
rec = {'id': 'synthetic', 'job': 'implement', 'harness': {'name': 'codex'}, 'model': {'requested': 'synthetic', 'ran': 'synthetic'}}
body = 'Checks\npass: one\nremain intact.\n\nSource: original\nCo-Authored-By: Synthetic <noreply@openai.com>'
before = 'docs: example\n\n' + body + '\n'
after = ns['_commit_message'](rec, {'commit': {'subject': 'docs: example', 'body': body}})
env = {'PATH': os.defpath, 'GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM': '1', 'GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL': '/dev/null', 'GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM': '/dev/null', 'LC_ALL': 'C'}
for message in (before, after):
 print(repr(message))
 print(subprocess.run(['git', 'interpret-trailers', '--parse'], input=message, text=True, capture_output=True, check=True, cwd='/', env=env).stdout)
